snippet.title: Shiny Gauntlet Trailer (teaser)
snippet.description:
Shiny Gauntlet is a Dungeon Hack n Slash, Bullet Hell, rogue-lite adventure. 

Select your champion and explore the Gauntlet. Collect weapons, enchanted rings, bottle and/or consume the mysterious remains of defeated foes, all the while chasing the Wily Cultist who has stolen your Shiny Shard!

Find out more about the game:
Website: https://shinygauntlet.com
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/ShinyGauntlet
Twitter: https://twitter.com/shinygauntlet

The Game is currently on Green Light. 
So be sure to check it out and vote!
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=428597835
